title: Frame to Cut
cast_lock: adult project lead in their early 50s, short gray hair, cream knit and navy work jacket
location_lock: quiet meeting room with an unbranded whiteboard, task cards, simple table and window light
prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: six-panel vertical social-video storyboard reference for ST-049 Frame to Cut
Primary request: create ONE polished contact-sheet image containing exactly six clearly separated sequential photorealistic frames of the same fictional adult in the same environment. It should feel like candid frames captured from a real phone-shot Instagram Reel or YouTube Short while remaining an original clean-room scene.
Subject continuity: fictional non-identifiable adult project lead in their early 50s, short gray hair, cream knit and navy work jacket. Ordinary natural face, realistic skin texture, restrained expression; same person, hair and wardrobe in all six panels.
Scene continuity: quiet meeting room with an unbranded whiteboard, task cards, simple table and window light. Same environment, props, time of day and left-to-right screen direction across all panels.
Persistent target: coherent cut. Trigger prop: film strip. Proof prop: motion match. Obstacle: transitions are chosen for novelty.
Six panels in reading order:
1 close still: notices the film strip; show The film strip changes before the objective is secure. Emotional register: surprise.
2 wide still: locates the coherent cut; show The hero and persistent coherent cut share one scene; objective: assemble a readable six-second insert. Emotional register: orientation.
3 medium still: matches movement or information across each cut; show The hero attempts to match movement or information across each cut; the coherent cut visibly responds. Emotional register: concern.
4 over_shoulder still: matches movement or information across each cut; show The hero matches movement or information across each cut; the same coherent cut changes state on screen. Emotional register: agency.
5 macro still: checks the motion match; show The changed coherent cut remains visible while the motion match is isolated. Emotional register: confidence-with-caution.
6 medium still: returns the resolved target to the viewer; show The resolved coherent cut stays visible while the sequence returns to A-roll: the insert reads as one event. Emotional register: relief.
Final panel truth boundary: visually preserve room for a later editable limitation overlay meaning 'Final timing must follow recorded speech.', but render no words.
Style/medium: realistic phone-native documentary/editorial frame capture, vertical social video, modest sharpening, slight shadow noise, natural highlight rolloff, subtle handheld imperfection, no cinematic LUT and no beauty retouching.
Composition: contact sheet with six equal portrait-oriented cells in a 2-column by 3-row grid with clean neutral gutters. No titles or captions inside cells. Keep the face, hands, persistent target, trigger, obstacle and proof visible and internally consistent.
Lighting/mood: motivated soft window light plus a believable practical source; natural mixed light; emotional progression from recognition/concern to agency and cautious relief.
Constraints: exactly six panels; same fictional adult, wardrobe, environment and prop identities; realistic hands/anatomy; blank or abstract paper/screen surfaces for later editable overlays; no generated text; no logos; no watermark; no platform UI.
Avoid: celebrity or creator likeness, distinctive source composition, influencer reaction face, branded office or software UI, luxury styling, neon tech lighting, cinematic anamorphic effects, plastic skin, warped hands, extra fingers, duplicated/missing props, identity drift, wardrobe changes, impossible reflections, fake metrics, testimonial imagery, unsupported success symbolism, copied creator caption or CTA.
